polishes.description: ‘Kiss Ilya, Marry Shane, F**K ICE’ is a charity polish with a purpose. Like so many around the country, we are horrified and outraged by the gross abuses of power and violence perpetrated by ICE both on our streets and behind closed doors. Reports from attorneys, journalists, and human rights organizations have documented horrific abuses by ICE including prolonged detention without due process, family separations, medical neglect in detention facilities, and evidence of extreme physical and psychological mistreatment. For many immigrant families and advocates, these patterns represent not isolated failures, but systemic harm. We know it’s only polish, but we believe beauty should stand for something. 100% of proceeds will be donated to CHIRLA (Coalition for Humane Immigrant Rights) to provide real support for immigrant families. ‘Kiss Ilya, Marry Shane, F**K ICE’ features red, silver and gold metallic flakies and holographic glitters in an ultramarine blue crelly base! Paint your nails. Fund the fight! F**K ICE! 💙 NOTE: Since this is a charity polish, discount codes will not apply.
